essays.text:
日譯中（每小題 15 分，共 30 分）
①国の税金の使い道としてまず思いつくのは「社会保障」だろう。
「社会保障」は「社会保険」、
「社会福祉」、
「公的扶助」、
「保健医療・公衆衛生」からなり、国民の生活を支えるものである。また、軍により国を「防衛」すること、教育および科学の振興、道路などの整備といった「公共事業」にも国民から集めた税金が多く使われている。
②税関の主な使命として、1.国の安全・国民の安心の実現、2.適正かつ公平な関税等の徴収、そして、3.貿易の円滑化があげられる。1 は、たとえば銃、麻薬、偽物等の密輸を阻止することが含まれる。2 の適正かつ公平な関税等の徴収が国税収入における重要な額を保障することにつながる。そして、国際物流におけるセキュリティを確保しながら、企業と協力したり IT 化を推進したりして、通関手続きを効率化するのは 3 に当たる。

中譯日（每小題 20 分，共 40 分）
①即將面臨大學入學考試的林同學，由於喜歡數學精於數字，及希望將來從事確保收入穩定的工作，因此有人建議他就讀商管科系，學習一些會計、財稅相關的知識，由於是金錢往來的專業，法律的知識也是必要的，將來可以報考關務相關的公職。
②日本對於希望赴日觀光、進行商務或探親等短期停留目的之臺灣居民實施免簽證措施，凡持有有效之臺灣護照（其上登載有身分證字號）者得以在日本境內停留 90 日以內，但若因長期工作等目的赴日者，仍須另行申辦相關簽證。

mcq.passage: The three main components of personal finance are income, spending and savings. Income is the starting point of personal finance. It is the entire amount of cash inflow that one receives and can 6 to expenses, savings, investments, and protection. Income includes salaries, wages, dividends, and other sources of cash inflow. Spending is an outflow of cash and typically 7 the bulk of income goes. Spending is whatever an individual uses their income to buy, which includes rent, mortgage, groceries, hobbies, eating out, home furnishings, home repairs, travel, and entertainment. 8 manage spending is a critical aspect of personal finance. Individuals must ensure their spending is less than their income; otherwise, they won’t have enough money to cover their expenses 9 will fall into debt. Debt can be devastating financially, particularly with the high interest rates credit cards charge. Savings are the income left over after spending. Everyone should aim to have savings to cover large expenses or emergencies. However, this means not using all one’s income, which can be difficult. 10 the difficulty, everyone should strive to have at least a portion of savings to meet any fluctuations in income and spending—somewhere between three and twelve months of expenses.

mcq.q: Which of the following statements best summarizes the main idea of this passage?
opts: Greenland is incredibly valuable because of its rich natural resources.
Greenland’s history, economy, and location make it globally important.
The U.S. is working to take control of Greenland for expansion.
The U.S. is planning to deal with the challenges Greenland is facing.

mcq.q: According to the article, which of the following is not included in Greenland’s economic activities?
opts: Growing crops on a large scale.
Fishing with a focus on cod.

mcq.q: According to the passage, which historical event influenced Greenland’s strategic position?
opts: Icelandic people first established settlements in Greenland in 982 A.D.
Greenland pledged allegiance to the Norwegian king in the 1200s.
The U.S. was granted permission to build air bases in Greenland during World War II.
Greenland lost settlements in the 1400s due to climate cooling and Eskimo migrations.

mcq.q: According to the passage, which factor contributes to Greenland’s future economic development?
opts: Greenland’s economy is stable due to Danish support.
Greenland’s melting Arctic ice is creating new routes.
Greenland’s people are mainly Eskimos and Scandinavians.
Greenland’s population is concentrated on the southwest coast.

mcq.q: According to the passage, what was the reason U.S. President Trump proposed purchasing Greenland in2019?
opts: To support Greenland in becoming more independent.
To preserve Greenland’s environment and wildlife.
Because Greenland has been dominated by the Danish government.
Because Greenland has the strategic location and valuable resources.
